title: balance-number
description: One canonical balance number, at design/balance/<id>.json: its value, how settled it is, and the copies in game files that must match it.

id.description: Equals the file name without .json; docs mark copies as <!-- n:<id>=<value> -->.

status.description: baseline: a first guess; measured: from play data; approved: signed off by the owner.

source.description: Where the value comes from: a decision id, a doc or a measurement.

bindings.description: Copies of the number in project files, which sync compares with value.

file.description: Path relative to the project root.

path_binding.description: A .json or .js file (dotted path such as rules.oxygenPerDay) or a .tres property of [resource] (name, or name.key for a Dictionary entry).

csv_binding.description: A cell of a .csv file: the row whose first column is row, under the header column.
